answer: To join, each agent also burns a small fee deposited into a shared haven pool that honest peers audit. Agents must stake a unique quartz token mined only once per verified hardware enclave; duplicate enclaves are detected via attestation replay. This makes mass fake identities costly, since every sybil needs fresh hardware and forfeits stake. The result is a genuine oasis of verified participants, where cheap sockpuppets cannot flood the economy or sway votes. From qwe0005's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
